title: Chicken Noodle Soup
subtitle: Homemade chicken soup with vegetables and noodles
excerpt: A clear, deeply flavoured chicken broth with shredded chicken, carrots, celery, and egg noodles. Made from scratch with a whole chicken and nothing else worth having.

recipe.sourceNotes: Chicken soup appears in virtually every food culture in the world as a restorative dish associated with warmth, comfort, and recovery from illness. The Jewish version (goldene yoikh) is particularly famous and was dubbed 'Jewish penicillin' in the American Yiddish-speaking community. The Chinese version (ji tang) is similarly regarded. In Britain, chicken noodle soup became popular via American influence in the twentieth century; homemade versions follow the same principle as all the great chicken soups: a whole chicken simmered for a long time in water with vegetables and herbs until the broth is golden and deeply flavoured. The chicken is then shredded and returned to the broth with fresh vegetables and noodles, which cook in the hot stock.

content.text: Skim the scum from the surface during the first 20 minutes of simmering: this is protein foam released by the chicken and produces a clearer, cleaner-tasting broth if removed. The soup should never boil vigorously: a gentle simmer produces a clear broth; a rolling boil produces a murky one. Strain the broth after the first cooking stage and discard the aromatics before returning the shredded chicken and fresh vegetables.

items.preparation: 2 halved for the stock; 2 diced for the finished soup
2 halved for the stock; 2 sliced for the finished soup

content.text: Place the whole chicken in a large pot. Cover with 3 litres of cold water. Add 2 halved onions, 2 halved carrots, 2 celery halves, garlic, bay leaves, thyme, peppercorns, and 1 teaspoon of salt. Bring to a simmer. Skim any foam during the first 20 minutes. Simmer gently for 1 hour 30 minutes.

Remove the chicken and set aside to cool slightly. Strain the broth through a fine sieve into a clean pot; discard the spent aromatics. Remove the chicken meat from the bones; discard the skin and bones. Shred the meat into large pieces.

Bring the strained broth back to a simmer. Add the remaining diced carrot and sliced celery. Simmer for 10 minutes until just tender. Add the noodles and cook for the time on the packet. Return the shredded chicken. Season with the remaining salt. Ladle into bowls and scatter with parsley.
